0.why: nilyniant.cpp:49-52 reads getVoltage() with no channel; lines 55 and 59 clamp both results to a floor of 0, so any negative note voltage gives the same output as C4
nilyniant.cpp:54-56 scales the note by 12 and by two thirds, clamped to 0 and 10, after setChannels(1) at line 62

1.why: nilyniant.cpp:58-60 scales the note by 12 and by one third, subtracts 0.171 and clamps to 0 and 10, after setChannels(1) at line 63

comment: Source read at commit c13145d. Neither output is rounded, so the voltage rises smoothly between notes rather than in steps; it is the receiving sequencer that quantises it to a sequence number. The Seq32 output subtracts a fixed 0.171 before clamping, which places C4 at the floor of the range.
